name: ReplyLead cold email benchmark aggregates
population: 115 sending campaigns across five client and two internal programmes; 81 campaigns meet the 500-contact floor. Cumulative counters at the snapshot, not a monthly or full-year sample.

definitions.reply: Unique responding contact within a campaign; automatic replies included. Does not establish positive intent, a meeting or a sale.
definitions.contacted_leads_sum: Sum of campaign-level contacted counts; people are not deduplicated across campaigns.
definitions.pooled_reply_rate_per_contact_percent: 100 × sum(unique replies) / sum(contacted leads) within the stated cohort. Campaigns with more contacts carry more weight.
definitions.median_campaign_reply_rate_per_contact_p: Unweighted median of campaign reply/contact percentages; provided for the two whole-population summaries.
definitions.size_bands: Contact-count bands at the snapshot date, not planned send volume or randomized groups.

limitations: One operator, heterogeneous offers and audiences, repeated programmes; not a representative market sample.
Campaign size is associated with targeting, duration and other differences. These figures do not establish a volume effect or predict another campaign.
Automatic replies are included; comparisons with datasets excluding them require qualification.
No positive-reply, booking, held-meeting, opportunity or revenue outcome is measured here.

summary.cohort: Campaigns with at least 500 contacted leads

citation: ReplyLead (2026), Cold Email Benchmarks 2026; cumulative counters extracted 12 August 2026; campaign-size analysis published 10 September 2026. https://replylead.com/cold-email-benchmarks.html
